name: RhfField
description: Bind an existing typed field to RHF, preserving its label, normalisation and reserved error line.
signature: <T extends FieldValues, N extends FieldPath<T>, P extends object, O = T>({ component: Component, control, name, rules, defaultValue, shouldUnregister, disabled, exact, ...props }: RhfFieldProps<T, N, P, O>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: component
props.description: Existing bound component, such as EmailField, IpField, PortField or MoneyField.

props.name: control
props.description: Inherited from the underlying primitive. Its accepted values are specified by the type.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: exact
props.description: Inherited from the underlying primitive. Its accepted values are specified by the type.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: rules
props.description: Inherited from the underlying primitive. Its accepted values are specified by the type.

props.name: shouldUnregister
props.description: Inherited from the underlying primitive. Its accepted values are specified by the type.
